title: 208 L 5 Star Direct Cool Single Door Refrigerator (RDC240A)
description: The Voltas Beko 208 L 5‑Star Direct Cool Single Door Refrigerator features Fresh Box Technology to keep produce crisp, along with Quick Freeze and a dedicated Chiller Zone for faster, efficient cooling. Its Base Drawer adds convenient extra storage, while adjustable toughened glass shelves offer flexible organization. Designed for high energy efficiency in a vibrant Bonita Blue finish
